source: Where each gun's shell leaves it relative to the player's arrow: height_m above the ground under the arrow, ahead_m in front of it along the line of fire (mtc_ballistics::LaunchPoint). Fitted (landings interpolated between frames, as the HUD's solver) to shots measured in game, by crates/mtc-ballistics/examples/calibration_fit.rs. Weapons not measured take a measured one's (like); the rest take default. Most measured shots were fired east or west; L9A1's were fired at 41-82 and 182 degrees and fit with ahead_m along the line of fire.

measured.from: M109A6, debug map, 10 shots 2-60 degrees, RMS 3.0 m
M109, Zone 11 and Arctic Airbase, 11 shots M107 Low 10.5-24 degrees (gun on the zoomed V1), RMS 4.9 m; the height is loose there (0-2.35 m). M284's values missed these by -8.2 m (RMS 9.8 m)
